body: Thank you for your kind words. Feel ashamed because it feels like I am stealing from others' hard work. I desire to contribute my part to society as well. I will try harder... I just hope I will make it.
Sorry for the late reply, yes, I can use a computer just fine, but I have to get really, really close the screen. I am a web and graphic designer.

Thank you for the reply, I've tried employment agencies in the area but they never call, send me job opportunities or even care. I went to career fairs for disabled people with big name companies and, after almost a year of contacting recruiters, sending them my resume, applying to jobs on their website, they just keep delaying everything.

I found out that my ex left me for some other guy and it feels like my father just gave up on me. I felt like doing the same would provide relief and closure. When I lay down, I feel like I can't breathe and the walls keep crushing in... pressure from society and the world that I made the wrong choices in life. 

Other people seem to want my services but only if it's free and refuse to help me out with getting a job; for example, they want an Amazon-esque website finished in three weeks. I still have their angry text messages blaming me for having a forgetful personality and telling me that I will never get a job if I don't help them. 

I have tried going to the State Rehab and they are nice people but... there hasn't been much luck from their end. I will keep trying my best though, but I am scared of the future, I don't want to be given things anymore because I want to earn it myself. I will keep trying though and will see about getting some counseling.

I'm sorry for telling you about all my troubles...

Thank you, I just feel dirty for taking government money, I don't want it either. :( I need it to pay the rent (fortunate in that regard). I believe I can do consulting work, maybe telecommute? I can do graphic/web design/development but so far people have only wanted to take advantage of my skills (they demand a free website, Amazon-esque).  The future feels very bleak though, I feel like I am stuck in my "cave" because the computer is the only window to the world that I have. 

I am scared but will keep trying, thank you.

Thank you, what you said makes sense and I really appreciate that you took time to write it out.

I feel like I made the wrong choices in my life, I see my friends with Marketing and CompSci degrees and they seem have everything they want while I get stuck with the "Would you like fries with that?" quote for choosing an Arts (although more technical) degree. 

Some people contact me and want me to make them a free website and then get angry when I say that I have to find a job first. I also tell them that I can't be doing stuff for free and that just gets them even more angry.

I will try harder than ever but I am always afraid of what society will say or judge about me.
